title: The Wrong Visitor
author: Emrys Whitlock
blurb: Isandro Quintana, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
